alt: A small galley kitchen from the doorway with a potted blooming houseplant on the counter catching window light, viewed in five different material schemes ranging from warm neutral to deep forest green to minimalist white.
text:
a single plant blooms, and the kitchen is suddenly about something other than its geometry.

the houseplant catches the window. light moves through the space—warm and specific. five material worlds, each one showing the same quiet shift: from geometry to luminescence.

light has a reason to be here now.

#kitchenlight #houseplantblooms #quietmoments #indoorplants #windowlight
